dialogue_texts: Wandering through a grand estate under the cover of midnight... How nostalgic.
It almost reminds me of the old days back at the Lunar Capital.
Fusana has transformed into her nighttime princess attire, but the Glohm entirely chokes her mind.
A princess of the night, you say? How amusing. I've seen her nighttime appearance before.
No need to warn me. Let us see if her royalty holds any real weight.
I would gladly dance with her to snap her out of it, but I cannot risk catching the infection myself.
Please, use your eternal power to strip the glohm away. I shall wait in a safe place.
A wise retreat for someone so fragile. Stay behind my shadow, then.
I shall cross this boundary and see what kind of performance this copycat has prepared.
Do not disturb my eternal rest...
Unless my partner wakes me with a kiss, I shall drag this entire night into a beautiful nightmare...
My dear, you are speaking to the true mistress of the eternal night.
If a kiss from your cowardly partner won't wake you, perhaps a taste of the Hourai Elixir's light will?
Impertinent exile... You understand nothing of the Order's grandeur! Fade away into the frozen dark!
Oh, I do so despise uninvited guests trying to dictate the terms of my evening.
Let us see if your little nighttime pageant can withstand the true, unyielding eternity of the Moon!
